data.body: Correction: an earlier Phase 1 legitimacy comment on this ticket described the separate `fcntl.flock` Windows failure and belongs to `oxymoronic-industrial-wrasse`. The RCA for THIS ticket is the Windows env-var limit in pytest’s `PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST`: run 33426859481 fails at `_pytest.runner._update_current_test_var` while setting a nodeid containing the 60,000-character `far_over_limit` parameter from `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_outbound_comment_marker_survives_truncation.py`. Local measurement before repair: collected nodeids are 60,163 chars for `far_over_limit` and 75,169 chars for `over_limit_multiline`; simulating the Windows cap raises the same `ValueError` at 60,171 chars. Legitimacy: test-harness defect; product input remains large, only pytest's generated id is unsafe. Attribution: commit 6724e79e8ff857b54dd36a62006a89445fc10ad6 / ticket 5931-78a3-95d2-44cd added the long parametrization without explicit short ids.
